name: km-personal-tax-domicile
description: Comoros (Union of the Comoros) personal tax domicile for tax year 2026: who is fiscally domiciled and so liable to IRPP on worldwide income, linking the new CGI article 50 bis of Finance Law 2026 (Law 25-020/AU) to the older article 45 tests of the 2023 General Tax Code. Sets out the permanent-home and economic-interests alternatives, the unresolved relationship with the older broader tests, source taxation of non-domiciled persons, the KMF 150,000 exemption, the 31 March return, and arrival and departure rules (art. 123 to 125: provisional declaration at least thirty days before departure, full payment on departure, tax clearance at emigration). Distinguishes domestic domicile from treaty allocation and gives no day-count safe harbour. Use for questions such as: am I tax resident in Comoros, is there a 183-day rule, what do I file when I leave Comoros. Historic IRPP bands are not certified as 2026 rates. Not reviewed by an accountant.
